def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    cw = [[grid[n - 1 - r][c] for r in range(n)] for c in range(n)]
    ccw = [[grid[r][n - 1 - c] for r in range(n)] for c in range(n)]
    half = [[grid[n - 1 - r][n - 1 - c] for c in range(n)] for r in range(n)]
    out = []
    for r in range(n):
        out.append(grid[r][:] + cw[r])
    for r in range(n):
        out.append(ccw[r] + half[r])
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = next(c for c in range(w) if all(row[c] != 0 for row in grid))
    left = [c for c in range(sep) if any(row[c] != 0 for row in grid)]
    right = [c for c in range(sep + 1, w) if any(row[c] != 0 for row in grid)]
    n = min(len(left), len(right))
    return [[2 if row[left[j]] != 0 and row[right[j]] != 0 else 0
             for j in range(n)] for row in grid]

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(range(10), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    divider = next((c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h))), None)
    if divider is None:
        return out

    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
             if grid[r][c] not in (bg, 2)]
    if not cells:
        return out

    min_c = min(c for r, c in cells)
    max_c = max(c for r, c in cells)

    if max_c < divider:              # object on the left
        shift = divider - 1 - max_c
        for r, c in cells:
            out[r][c] = bg
        for r, c in cells:
            out[r][c + shift] = grid[r][c]
        marker = min_c + shift - 1
    else:                             # object on the right
        shift = divider + 1 - min_c
        for r, c in cells:
            out[r][c] = bg
        for r, c in cells:
            out[r][c + shift] = grid[r][c]
        marker = max_c + shift + 1

    if 0 <= marker < w:
        for r in range(h):
            out[r][marker] = 8
    return out

def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter, deque

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [[bg] * w for _ in range(h)]
    seen = [[False] * w for _ in range(h)]

    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg or seen[r][c]:
                continue

            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen[r][c] = True
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if (0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and not seen[ny][nx]
                            and grid[ny][nx] == color):
                        seen[ny][nx] = True
                        q.append((ny, nx))

            minr = min(y for y, x in cells)
            maxr = max(y for y, x in cells)
            minc = min(x for y, x in cells)
            maxc = max(x for y, x in cells)
            area = (maxr - minr + 1) * (maxc - minc + 1)
            if area >= 4 and len(cells) / area >= 0.65:
                for y in range(minr, maxr + 1):
                    for x in range(minc, maxc + 1):
                        out[y][x] = color
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter

    base = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

    # Grid lines have substantially fewer cells of the dominant interior color.
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if sum(v == base for v in grid[r]) < w / 2]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == base for r in range(h)) < h / 2]

    if not rows or not cols:
        return [[base]]

    # Ignore unmarked edge lines; keep lines participating in the marker pattern.
    sep = Counter(grid[r][c] for r in rows for c in cols).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cols = [c for c in cols if any(grid[r][c] != sep for r in rows)]

    out = []
    for r1, r2 in zip(rows, rows[1:]):
        line = []
        for c1, c2 in zip(cols, cols[1:]):
            corners = [grid[r1][c1], grid[r1][c2],
                       grid[r2][c1], grid[r2][c2]]
            line.append(corners[0] if corners.count(corners[0]) == 4
                        and corners[0] != sep else base)
        out.append(line)
    return out

def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    separator = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != background).most_common(1)[0][0]

    rows = [r for r in range(h) if sum(v == separator for v in grid[r]) > w / 2]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == separator for r in range(h)) > h / 2]

    def is_marker(r, c):
        return grid[r][c] != background and grid[r][c] != separator

    active_rows = [i for i, r in enumerate(rows) if any(is_marker(r, c) for c in cols)]
    active_cols = [j for j, c in enumerate(cols) if any(is_marker(r, c) for r in rows)]
    if not active_rows or not active_cols:
        return []

    rows = rows[min(active_rows):max(active_rows) + 1]
    cols = cols[min(active_cols):max(active_cols) + 1]

    out = []
    for r1, r2 in zip(rows, rows[1:]):
        line = []
        for c1, c2 in zip(cols, cols[1:]):
            a, b = grid[r1][c1], grid[r1][c2]
            c, d = grid[r2][c1], grid[r2][c2]
            line.append(a if a == b == c == d and is_marker(r1, c1) else background)
        out.append(line)
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter, deque

    bg = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen = set()

    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue

            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if (0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and
                            (ny, nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color):
                        seen.add((ny, nx))
                        q.append((ny, nx))

            r0 = min(y for y, x in cells)
            r1 = max(y for y, x in cells)
            c0 = min(x for y, x in cells)
            c1 = max(x for y, x in cells)
            if r1 - r0 < 2 or c1 - c0 < 2:
                continue

            border = set()
            for x in range(c0, c1 + 1):
                border.add((r0, x))
                border.add((r1, x))
            for y in range(r0, r1 + 1):
                border.add((y, c0))
                border.add((y, c1))

            if set(cells) == border:
                fill = 7 if (c1 - c0 - 1) % 2 else 2
                for y in range(r0 + 1, r1):
                    for x in range(c0 + 1, c1):
                        out[y][x] = fill

    return out

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for v in row:
            counts[v] = counts.get(v, 0) + 1
    bg = max(counts, key=counts.get)

    seen = set()
    components = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            comp = []
            while stack:
                x, y = stack.pop()
                comp.append((x, y))
                for nx, ny in ((x-1, y), (x+1, y), (x, y-1), (x, y+1)):
                    if (0 <= nx < h and 0 <= ny < w and
                            grid[nx][ny] != bg and (nx, ny) not in seen):
                        seen.add((nx, ny))
                        stack.append((nx, ny))
            components.append(comp)

    if not components:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]

    template = max(components, key=len)
    r0 = min(r for r, c in template)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in template)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in template)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in template)
    anchor_r = (r0 + r1) // 2
    anchor_c = (c0 + c1) // 2
    pattern = [(r - anchor_r, c - anchor_c, grid[r][c])
               for r, c in template]

    template_set = set(template)
    triggers = [comp[0] for comp in components if comp is not template and len(comp) == 1]

    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for tr, tc in triggers:
        for dr, dc, color in pattern:
            rr, cc = tr + dr, tc + dc
            if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                out[rr][cc] = color
    return out
